szenen.vo: Your comfort zone feels safe. Warm. Easy.
[intense] But it's a trap. Nothing grows in there. Nothing.

[intense] Outside, it gets scary first. Then you learn. Then you grow.
[shouting] Everything you want is waiting one step outside!
[whispers] Feeling uncomfortable? [intense] That's the sign you're growing.

[shouting] Get out of the circle. And GROW!
